conflicts.permit: The Personal Information that I collect is used for providing and improving the Service.
conflicts.prohibit: The information that I request will be retained on your device and is not collected by me in any way.
conflicts.situation: When a user provides personally identifiable information requested by the developer while using the service.
conflicts.reason: The developer asserts that they collect personal information to provide/improve the service, but simultaneously claims requested information is not collected by them in any way without reconciling the two.
